newsitem.title: USA: CME says CFTC approves pork belly limit changes.
newsitem.headline: CME says CFTC approves pork belly limit changes.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) said that the Commodity Futures Trading Commission has approved an increase in the daily price limits on the Frozen Pork Belly futures contract to $.030 per lb from $.020 per lb.
The changes become effective on currently listed contracts Tuesday, October 8, 1996.

The CFTC also approved the expansion of daily price limits by 50 percent to $.045 per lb, for all contract months, if the contract nearest to expiration that is subject to a daily price limit closes on the limit bid for two successive days, or on the limit offer for two successive days.
The expanded limits would remain in place until such time as the contract nearest to expiration does not close at the limit bid or the limit offer, CME added.
